acceptance: Title equals menu label; one header pattern.

requirements.title: Off-duty requests in a list + detail split view
requirements.requirement: Requests use the list-left / detail-right pattern from Qualifications on desktop.
acceptance: Same endpoints and request payloads before and after (network-log comparison); old URLs and deep links keep working.
Every drawer action remains reachable.

requirements.title: Off-duty decisions in the unified approvals queue
requirements.requirement: Pending off-duty requests appear in the single Approvals queue and open the request.
acceptance: Decision rules, permissions and self-review blocking unchanged.
Control visibility comes only from access flags or operations the server returns; the server stays the authority and still refuses unauthorized requests (no permission logic moves into components).

requirements.title: Off-duty inspection read without review permission
requirements.requirement: Decide and apply the read policy for off-duty inspections by users without review permission.
acceptance: Decision recorded; DB test covers the chosen rule.
requirements.notes: OWNER DECISION NEEDED (open B8 read-policy gap; B8a addressed the inspector 404).

requirements.title: Off-duty re-notification no longer fails silently
requirements.requirement: Off-duty notification upserts use onConflict department_id,user_id,notification_key, so a resubmitted or re-decided request notifies reviewers and the officer instead of erroring into console.error.
acceptance: Route test: resubmitting a returned request creates or refreshes the reviewer notification without error.
Route test: Returned then Approved delivers an approval notice to the officer.
requirements.notes: B6 covers the TRN-19 silent-failure part only. Fixed in code on claude/fix-b6-notification-delivery (not merged; waits for B6 infrastructure authorization). Email and inbox source are MOD-OFFD-026.

requirements.title: Off-duty approval notifications are emailed and filterable as an Off-Duty source
requirements.requirement: Off-duty notifications go through the shared notification writer, including email queuing, and 'Off-Duty' is a source in the inbox payload and in notification preferences, so reviewers are emailed about pending approvals and users can filter and mute the source.
acceptance: Submitting an off-duty request queues an email to each reviewer (notification_email_queue row).
The inbox payload labels these items with source Off-Duty, and the source appears in the filter and preferences.
Reviewer permissions stay server-side; no change to who may approve (§1b).
requirements.notes: The UI source filter built from the payload is MOD-NOTIF-003.
